title: JEPA World Models: From Prediction to Decisions
summary: An evidence-led tutorial that tests when predictive representations help action selection—and when accurate prediction is not enough.
description: This research tutorial connects JEPA representation learning, action-conditioned prediction, planning, uncertainty, and decision evaluation. It includes small local LeJEPA objective studies, a verified inference check with an official V-JEPA 2.1 checkpoint, and clearly labeled MountainCar analogues that expose the gap between one-step prediction and closed-loop control. Toy results are not presented as paper reproductions. A genuine learned-JEPA-versus-direct-policy benchmark remains future work.

status.label: Active research tutorial
status.summary: Local lessons and evidence are available. Notebook 22's learned visual JEPA comparison remains gated after a failed GPU validation pilot. Large paper benchmarks remain pending.

researchQuestion: When do predictive representations actually improve action selection, and when does accurate prediction fail to translate into effective decisions?

verifiedFindings.title: SIGReg changed feature statistics without a measured probe gain
verifiedFindings.summary: On a five-seed CIFAR-10 subset study, the paired frozen-probe difference was -0.24 percentage points, with a 95% interval of [-1.591, 1.111] points. The interval includes zero.
verifiedFindings.scope: 640 self-supervised images, small CNN, five seeds; local objective study only.
verifiedFindings.claimBoundary: Not the LeJEPA ImageNet-1K result; does not establish general superiority or inferiority.

verifiedFindings.title: RDMReg improved the local projector probe over a degenerate teaching proxy
verifiedFindings.summary: The paired projector-probe difference was +6.94 percentage points, with a 95% interval of [2.918, 10.962]. Encoder-probe scores were similar.
verifiedFindings.scope: Five-seed CIFAR-10 subset study with a local CNN and projector.
verifiedFindings.claimBoundary: The teaching proxy was often near zero and fully zero on one seed. This is not the paper's ImageNet-100 result.

verifiedFindings.title: Near-perfect action ranking did not make local MPC successful
verifiedFindings.summary: The state model ranked 60/60 non-tied action pairs correctly, yet MPC reached 0/20 goals and a direct momentum rule reached 20/20. The planner used 7.68 million model transitions and 12.747 seconds; the rule used no model transitions and 0.007 seconds.
verifiedFindings.scope: One deterministic polynomial Ridge model; MountainCarContinuous; 20 paired starts.
verifiedFindings.claimBoundary: Not a JEPA result or matched-actual-compute comparison. It applies only to the recorded local task and settings.

verifiedFindings.title: A hand-written controller prior changed CEM outcomes
verifiedFindings.summary: On 20 paired starts, neutral-start CEM reached 0/20 goals; momentum-prior CEM and direct control each reached 20/20. Direct control used zero model calls and averaged fewer steps than the prior planner.
verifiedFindings.scope: One fixed color-moment feature extractor and one Ridge fit on rendered MountainCar frames.
verifiedFindings.claimBoundary: The prior is hand-written, not a learned policy. This is not PiJEPA or a learned JEPA planner.

verifiedFindings.title: Planner-shift coverage intervals were wider across five fits
verifiedFindings.summary: For 90% prediction intervals, mean position coverage was 90.7% [89.7%, 91.7%] on random actions and 89.0% [82.2%, 95.7%] under planner shift.
verifiedFindings.scope: Five independent state-space Ridge ensembles on MountainCarContinuous.
verifiedFindings.claimBoundary: Not a JEPA uncertainty result; five fits and one task do not establish general calibration.

pendingWork.title: Learned visual JEPA decision comparison
pendingWork.summary: On an RTX 5070, the 35-epoch SIGReg pilot and a local VICReg-style probe both fell below the predeclared embedding-spread threshold in all 32 dimensions. The replacement final seeds, held-out interventions, and paired episode comparison remain unopened. Earlier five-seed fits are retained as excluded pre-gate diagnostics.
pendingWork.claimBoundary: This is a local configuration failure. It does not establish a general JEPA result or show whether a learned visual JEPA improves decisions.

media.alt: Separate MountainCar plots compare closed-loop success for a state-model planner and direct momentum rule, and for neutral CEM, hand-written momentum-prior CEM, and direct control. Both neutral planners fail all 20 starts despite perfect local intervention ranking.
media.caption: Closed-loop success on separate 20-start evaluations. Error bars are Wilson intervals across starts, not training runs.

media.alt: Position and velocity coverage of nominal 90 percent prediction intervals on random-action and planner-shift tests. Means are near 90 percent; planner-shift confidence intervals are wider.
media.caption: Coverage means and 95% Student-t intervals across five independent state-space model fits.
